scope: Actual bundled bounded SFX handlers: partial supported/refused inventory, canonical shared import owner, consent, source/project races, cancellation, input ownership and historical evidence. No browser layout, listening or native-engine equivalence claim.

results.name: SFX controls mount once inside native Audio with explicit acknowledgement and native selector
Missing session and unknown source cannot stage or mutate an Audio project
Visible inventory proves finite IDs with per-effect support and refusal reasons
Finite preview shows current identity, timing, conversion differences and no mutation
Unsupported multichannel SFX displays its refusal and preserves authoring data
Incompatible project timing gives actionable refusal without changing music tempo or speed
Acknowledgement and explicit cancelled confirmation retain stage without mutation
Confirmed import rebases canonical patterns and SFX while retaining music, settings and native edits
One Undo, Redo and save/reopen preserve the exact editable imported SFX
Native WIP edits, new inspected sources and subsong changes reject stale staged SFX
Project edits, identical replacement epochs and dialog mutations refuse stale imports
Delayed inventory and preview reject project, source, option and cancellation races
Older cancelled operations cannot clear a newer inventory or supported preview
Async revalidation races refuse before confirmation and cancellation also guards commit
Changed conversion results and capacity failures never reach canonical mutation
Native selector keeps keyboard defaults and blocks emulator controls while focused
Evidence exports complete historical provenance before and after source replacement
Evidence Save As cancel, busy, error and delayed completions preserve honest status
Presentation cleanup failure still leaves a dirty committed SFX with truthful status
